profile.headline: Software craftsman embracing new paradigms.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
A spin off of 3M, Health Information Systems division; formerly M*Modal

Built and extended RESTful Java microservices with Spring Boot, including backfilling unit tests:
Index FHIR document resources in Solr (including writing and deploying the configset);
Perform CRUD+ (includes versioning) operations on FHIR resources;
Translate 3M medical provider resources into FHIR-compliant Practitioners; and
Automate reprocessing FHIR resources when the NLU module is updated.
Authored and configured automated Jenkins pipelines to compile; test; analyze static code, security, and license compliance; and deploy to Continuous Integration environment.  Consequently, I decreased vulnerabilities in multiple projects from hundreds to tens, addressing all critical and high severity results, and triaging medium and lower priority items.
Migrated entire CI/CD pipeline from Jenkins to GitHub Workflows and Actions in order to minimize auditable surface for government contract compliance.
Performed microservice and Solr cluster operational tasks, including: Dockerization, writing Ansible playbooks for installation and upgrade deployments, configuration, and performance tuning.
Supported DevOps in corporate datacenter while moving into multiple AWS environments, including large rewrites of Ansible playbooks and roles, and trained teammates on operational protocols, procedures, and best practices.
Advocated for Agile practices and Behavior-Driven Development in 2018 and 2019 annual internal “Closed Loop” conferences (respectively), to audiences of around 50.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring MVC · Microservices · Amazon EC2 · Jenkins · REST APIs · Test Automation · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) · GitHub · Apache Kafka · Spring Framework · Kubernetes · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Copilot

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborating with University of Pittsburgh Medical Center (UPMC) Enterprises on Next Generation Imaging -- software to help radiologists read radiologic exams better, faster.

• Observe radiologists at work to inform workflow software design suggestions.
• Drive consensus on database schema and query changes.
• Advocate for technical excellence within the quality process.
• Implement REST API in Java service layer.
• Develop and refactor AngularJS components (directives, controllers, services, etc.) for web application client.
• Assist other teams in development and code review.
• Write Gherkin automated tests with JBehave, Serenity BDD, and Selenium web driver.

Technologies used: JavaScript, AngularJS, Jasmine, Underscore.js, Node.js, Less.js, CSS, Java, Spring Data JPA, Serenity BDD, JBehave, JUnit, Selenium Web Driver, Gherkin, IntelliJ IDEA, C++, Microsoft Visual Studio 2008, MFC, Perforce , Sybase ASE, Windows command shell, Bash shell, Rally, HP ALM, Windows 7.
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · REST APIs · Test Automation

positions.title: Software Engineer, Architect, and DevOps Freelancer
positions.description:
• Prototyped a scheduling app for Covi Point, aiming to duplicate existing web and iOS app functionality, on Android phone and tablet.

• Helped BluPanda extend healthcare logistics iOS enterprise app functionality while simplifying code base through use of inheritance and other standard object­-oriented design patterns.
• Added additional sort functions, centralized data model and store, reduced code duplication, unified iPhone/iPad view controllers, wrote unit tests, and set up daily automated build and local deployment jobs.

Skills used:
• Took initiative in simplifying client source code using standard inheritance pattern and upgrading to newer developer tools.
• Educated colleagues in distributed source control.
• Participated in establishing iterative development process.
• Identified poor user experience and proposed several options for remediation.

Technologies used: Xcode 4, Xcode 5, Objective­-C, iOS SDK, git, Bash shell, Jenkins, Samba, Mac OS X 10.8, Eclipse, Java, Android SDK

positions.title: Mobile and Tablets Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with small team to port Belo WeatherCaster iPad weather app to Android phone.
• Responsibilities focussed on user interface development, with an emphasis on user­-friendly displays of complicated XML and JSON server data.

Technologies used: Eclipse, Java, Android SDK, Xcode, Objective­C, iOS SDK, Mac OS X 10.7 and 10.8, Jira, git, Subversion, Bash shell

positions.title: Software Development Engineer, Kindle Fire
positions.description:
• Implemented parental controls policies in multiple projects for a major Kindle Fire software update.
• Reviewed and suggested clarifications to user interface design, and implemented substantial functionality for, Kindle FreeTime, a built-in Kindle Fire application that presents a safe environment for children’s content. 
• Collaborated on backend services to support Kindle FreeTime, including functionality, gathering metrics, and performance tuning.

Technologies used: Eclipse, Java, Android SDK, Windows 7, Jira, Kindle Fire, git, Perforce, Bash shell, Windows command shell, RHEL5

positions.title: Mac Developer
positions.description:
• Tested and incorporated internal cross-platform frameworks.
• Contributed to wireless and mobility solutions & device management software.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
•	Designed (in consultation with team members) and implement internal engines and interfaces in C++ for security and privacy software.
•	Created and tested platform-specific methods for manipulating files, forks, blocks, and sectors on disk using Core Foundation / Carbon libraries and Win32 APIs.
•	Automated unit testing with the Google C++ Testing Framework.
•	Analyzed software performance to identify and improve inefficient and incorrect code.
•	Created custom GUI elements, set up automated build and test systems, and package software for distribution for OS X.
•	Co-wrote targeted malware cleanup utility "OSX/OpinionSpy Free Detection + Removal Tool."

company.name: Javacool Software Development, LLC (now BrightFort Software Development, LLC)

positions.title: Residential Computing Assistant
positions.description: I provided technical support for approx. 180 students in a dormitory.  My primary responsibilities included virus and malware cleanup and computer lab maintenance.

positions.title: Assistant to the Operations Manager
positions.description:
I set up and served a bi-weekly dinner for 45-60 students.
I further acted as greeter and phone-answerer when on desk shift.
Mostly, though, I made sure that the building ran smoothly for daily and special activities.

company.name: Newberger Hillel Center at the University of Chicago

positions.title: WebTeam Intern
positions.description: Augmented and modularized in-house scripts: one for creating and modifying virtual hosts on a webserver; and several for security scans, catching thousands of previously-undetected security policy violations.

positions.title: WebTeam Intern
positions.description: Augmented legacy scripts to fix adding and change virtual host entries in a web server configuration file, detect files that violate lab policy, and restart other monitoring services when they fail.

positions.title: Primary Integration Tester
positions.description: I product-tested an online, fifth-grade mathematics curriculum, trying to find bugs or ways to trick the computer.  For each problem, I would try permutations of the correct answer(s), other ways to say the same thing, and answers that seemed likely to cause problems.

projects.title: TurkRater - Rating and Reviews platform for Amazon mTurk
projects.description:
Engineered the requirements and designed the concept of a rating and review platform for the existing Amazon's mechanical Turk system. 

The project's intention was to understand and get hands-on experience on the requirements analysis techniques like Market research, Goal modeling, Use case analysis, prototyping, story boarding, natural mapping etc.

projects.title: Belo WeatherCaster
projects.description: We ported an iPad weather app to Android phone concurrently with its port to iPhone.
